lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「凛として振る舞う事の大切さ」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your daddy teaches us how important it is to carry ourselves with dignity, doesn't he.
lines.style: Soft unhurried warmth; gentle downward melody, patient pace pitched for a small child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「家族の為に尽くされた事」を聞いたよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, Daddy told me all about how he gave everything for the family.
lines.style: Small careful voice gaining confidence mid-sentence; earnest child pride, slightly breathy proud finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが詰将棋の問題を出して下さるわ
lines.en: And your daddy sets you tsume-shogi puzzles to solve too, doesn't he, Sho.
lines.style: Light delighted lift; smiling tone, soft rise inviting the little one to chime in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと凛として歩く練習したよ
lines.en: Big Sis Mei, me and Daddy practiced walking all tall and proper!
lines.style: Eager burst on the opening name; quick proud rush, bright bounce on the finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと詰将棋の本を本屋で買ったわ
lines.en: And guess what, Sho — your daddy and I bought a tsume-shogi book at the bookstore.
lines.style: Playful conspiratorial hush opening into a warm smile; gentle slowing settle to close.
